# Example plan

## Lanes

| Lane | Repo | Lane time |
|---|---|---|
| L1: inbox / action items and header count | mtm (`projects/matomeru`) | 60–90 min |
| L2: o-gh PR page and signals | new `projects/o-gh` (or grow o-git) | 60–120 min |
| L3: o-mcp, the client package and its catalog | new `projects/o-mcp`, plus o-ai exposing its config readers as a package | 90–150 min |
| L4: o-slack | new `projects/o-slack` | 60–90 min (needs a Slack MCP credential) |
| L5: polling and schedules | mtm | 45–90 min |
